Pantheon.laning: When Pantheon steps forward to last-hit, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then take a short trade with Rumble Q Flamespitter. If you’ve pushed the lane too far, check river vision, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield for escape when you lack vision.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s impact falls off later, but it also becomes harder for Rumble to get close, so avoid forcing an engage.
Pantheon.teamfight: Engage from behind your frontline and position so multiple enemies are in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. Lower Pantheon’s magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, and don’t attack into the front of Pantheon E Aegis Assault. Cast Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline, or along their escape route, to restrict movement.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so be careful not to enter its range. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when taking poke from Pantheon Q Comet Spear. Stop attacking from the front during Pantheon E Aegis Assault, and attack when it ends or when you can angle in from the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Avoid stacking health alone because Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health.
Poppy.combo: For a basic trade, hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on her. Manage your Heat in a fight so you can activate Rumble Q Flamespitter in the Danger Zone. If Rumble R The Equalizer is available, cut off Poppy’s escape, then follow the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon with Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Poppy.escape: Right after you force Poppy to use Poppy E Heroic Charge is Rumble’s chance to close the gap. If you’ve confirmed Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict is also down, slow her with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and move in during the window when she’s less likely to interrupt you with forced movement. Don’t engage with a wall behind you while Poppy E Heroic Charge is still available.
Poppy.fight: Rumble has no spell to escape on his own, so don’t move in first while in range of Poppy E Heroic Charge. When Poppy steps up to last-hit, slow her with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then move to keep her in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. As you close the gap, check your Heat and use the shield and movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield.
Poppy.laning: Poke safely with Rumble E Electro Harpoon from a position with no wall behind you. When the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador falls, look for a chance to step on it so she can’t collect it for a shield. If you’ve pushed the lane too far, check river vision and save Rumble W Scrap Shield to disengage when vision is missing.
Poppy.phase: Later in the game, you can easily die before getting close, so avoid forcing an engage.
Poppy.teamfight: Engage from behind your frontline and position so multiple enemies in their frontline are in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. Lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage. Cast Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline, or along their escape route, to restrict movement.
Poppy.watch: Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you if it knocks you into a wall, so stand in open space with no wall behind you. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you once, immediately walk out of the remaining area. When you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

Quinn.build: The first item to purchase can’t be specified because the source doesn’t provide that information. Quinn deals physical damage, so prioritize armor if you build resistance, and don’t build magic resistance.
Quinn.combo: Once Quinn E Vault is down, hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then activate Rumble Q Flamespitter. To start a fight, build Heat with Rumble E Electro Harpoon until you enter the Danger Zone, then use Rumble Q Flamespitter. If Rumble R The Equalizer is available, use it first to cut off her escape.
Quinn.escape: Quinn E Vault knocks Rumble back and moves Quinn away, so don’t rush in beforehand. The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your chance to close the gap. While Quinn Q Blinding Assault narrows your vision, don’t throw Rumble E Electro Harpoon; just decide whether to move in or back away.
Quinn.fight: Quinn outranges you early, so don’t engage alone until Quinn E Vault is down. Once it’s down, slow her with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and use the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield to close the gap and keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on her.
Quinn.laning: Preserve your health and farm CS early, farming while Quinn P Harrier’s mark is absent. Poke safely with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then trade when Quinn steps up to last-hit and Quinn E Vault is down. If you push the lane, check river vision, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield for escape when vision is missing.
Quinn.phase: In the early lane, Rumble needs to preserve his health and hold on because Quinn outranges him. Rumble is strongest in the mid game as his ability power builds, and should avoid forcing his way onto Quinn late.
Quinn.teamfight: From behind your frontline, find a position to hit multiple enemies with Rumble Q Flamespitter, and reduce their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon. Cast Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline, or along their escape route, to restrict movement.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, watch out for her empowered basic attack and move out of her attack range to let the mark expire. Stand behind the minion wave to block Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and don’t force an engage while Quinn E Vault is available.

Riven.build: Riven’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, move defensive items earlier in your build and get some health to reduce the risk of being finished by Riven R Blade of the Exile.
Riven.combo: For a basic trade, hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on her. Watch your Heat so you can activate Rumble Q Flamespitter in the Danger Zone. When using your ultimate, cast Rumble R The Equalizer to cut off Riven’s escape, then follow the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon with Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Riven.escape: After Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions, you have an opening to go in before it comes back. If only Riven E Valor is down, she can still escape with Riven Q Broken Wings, so don’t go deep based on just one mobility spell being down. Once you’ve confirmed Riven W Ki Burst is also down, fight with less risk of being interrupted by its stun.
Riven.fight: While Riven’s dashes are available, keep your distance and wear her down with Rumble E Electro Harpoon. When she closes in, use Rumble W Scrap Shield with Heat built up to absorb damage and gain movement speed, then manage the distance.
Riven.laning: Rumble has no mobility and can be caught by Riven’s chained dashes, so don’t activate Rumble Q Flamespitter first when you have no angle to get close. Don’t stand forward with both charges of Rumble E Electro Harpoon spent; look for a chance to trade back when Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions. If you’ve pushed the lane and have no river vision, save Rumble W Scrap Shield to disengage.
Riven.phase: Early on, Rumble’s health and armor make close trades with Riven manageable, but manage your distance first so her dashes don’t catch you. Later, Rumble can easily die before getting close, so don’t go deep alone.
Riven.teamfight: Engage from behind your frontline and position so multiple enemies in their frontline are in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. Lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage. Use Rumble R The Equalizer to split their frontline from their backline in a fight already underway, or to cut off their escape.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings and Riven E Valor can chain dashes, so create distance as soon as you see the first dash. The third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings knocks you up, and Riven W Ki Burst stuns you, so watch out for her follow-up attacks if she catches you. When Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range increases and its damage based on missing health is also dangerous, so back away until it ends.

Sett.build: Build armor first to account for the physical damage from Sett P Pit Grit and Sett Q Knuckle Down. Armor can’t reduce the center’s true damage from Sett W Haymaker, so getting out of its path comes first. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: For a basic trade, use Rumble E Electro Harpoon → Rumble E Electro Harpoon → Rumble Q Flamespitter. For a longer fight, build Heat with Rumble E Electro Harpoon until you enter the Danger Zone, then activate Rumble Q Flamespitter. Briefly back off when Sett W Haymaker becomes stronger.
Sett.escape: Look for an opening when Sett E Facebreaker is down or Sett R The Show Stopper is unavailable. If you expect a counterattack from Sett W Haymaker, use Rumble W Scrap Shield to create distance.
Sett.fight: While Sett’s magic resistance is low early, wear him down with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and take short trades when he steps up to last-hit. Build up the slow with both charges of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then keep Sett in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. After dealing damage, use the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield to create distance and avoid the strong counterattack from Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.laning: Poke safely with Rumble E Electro Harpoon without pushing the lane too far. Don’t stand forward with both charges spent; when Sett steps up to last-hit, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then move in with Rumble Q Flamespitter. If you don’t have river vision, save Rumble W Scrap Shield for escape.
Sett.phase: Later in the game, Rumble can easily die before getting close, so don’t force your way onto Sett; manage your range and positioning.
Sett.teamfight: From behind your frontline, find a position to hit multiple enemies with Rumble Q Flamespitter, and lower Sett’s magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage. Cast Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline, or along their escape route, to restrict movement. Watch out for the center of Sett W Haymaker and Sett R The Show Stopper’s engage, and don’t force your way into their backline.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if there’s an enemy on each side of Sett, so avoid standing opposite a minion wave with Sett between you and the minions. Right after dealing damage with Rumble Q Flamespitter, Sett W Haymaker can become stronger, so create distance and sidestep the center of its indicator when it activates to avoid the true damage. If Sett R The Show Stopper catches you, you’re suppressed, so be especially careful with your distance while his ultimate is available.

Shen.build: The time spent taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash is dangerous, so consider tenacity first. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage, while Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so consider both types instead of building only one resistance. Avoid stacking health alone because Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health.
Shen.combo: For a basic trade, hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then activate Rumble Q Flamespitter. To start a fight, use the first Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build Heat into the Danger Zone, then activate Rumble Q Flamespitter. If you can cut off Shen’s escape, cast Rumble R The Equalizer to block his route, then follow with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Shen.escape: The moment after Shen E Shadow Dash misses is your chance to go in. However, if Shen R Stand United is still available, Shen still has an escape even if Shen E Shadow Dash is down, so check whether Shen R Stand United is also unavailable. If both charges of Rumble E Electro Harpoon have been used, you lack a reliable way to engage or disengage, so don’t force it.
Shen.fight: Right after dodging Shen E Shadow Dash, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and keep him in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. Use Rumble W Scrap Shield as you move in after building Heat, making use of its shield and movement speed. Even when Shen W Spirit’s Refuge is active, you can still deal ability damage with Rumble Q Flamespitter and Rumble E Electro Harpoon.
Shen.laning: Poke safely from a distance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon. When Shen steps forward to last-hit, slow him and move in with Rumble Q Flamespitter. Early on, take trades to gain lane priority and keep Shen occupied with CS. If you’ve pushed the lane too far, check river vision and save Rumble W Scrap Shield for escape when vision is missing.
Shen.phase: Shen is weak in lane early, so Rumble can look for trades and lane priority. However, Rumble has low magic resistance, so don’t underestimate the magic damage from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Later, Rumble can easily die before getting close, so avoid forcing an engage.
Shen.teamfight: Engage from behind your frontline and position so multiple enemy frontline champions are in range of Rumble Q Flamespitter. Lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, and cast Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline, or along their escape route, to restrict movement. If you see Shen preparing to join with Shen R Stand United, alert your team immediately and judge whether you can finish the fight before he arrives.
Shen.watch: If taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash, you’re likely to take empowered attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash before trading back. Also move out of the path of Shen’s spirit blade as it returns to him to reduce the degree of empowerment from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Shen W Spirit’s Refuge blocks basic attacks, but not abilities.

Singed.build: Singed’s main damage is magic, and Rumble has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots, and fit Force of Nature between your core items to stay near Singed longer.
Singed.combo: Your basic trade is to hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on. To start a fight, use Rumble E Electro Harpoon to reach the Danger Zone, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter. To cut off Singed’s escape route, place Rumble R The Equalizer first, then follow with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Singed.escape: Stay out of areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive, and look for a chance to close in after Singed E Fling has been used. Singed has no ability to create distance on his own, so use the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon to close the gap then. If Singed gets away with the movement speed from Singed P Noxious Slipstream while leaving Singed Q Poison Trail behind, don’t chase recklessly.
Singed.fight: Early on, when Singed steps up for a last hit, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then close in. Watch your heat, turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter in the Danger Zone, and use the shield and movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield to deal damage while staying close. If you don’t have enough damage left to finish him for sure, don’t chase along Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.laning: Use Rumble Q Flamespitter when you have an angle to get close; don’t spend the whole ability wave clearing. After pushing the lane, check river vision, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield to escape when you lack vision.
Singed.phase: However, Rumble is vulnerable to Singed’s magic damage, so build magic resistance from the early game.
Singed.teamfight: Enter from behind your frontline and catch several enemy frontline champions in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range. Lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, too. Instead of committing your team to Singed or chasing him to the end, limit his movement with the slows from Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble R The Equalizer, then attack his allies.
Singed.watch: Do not chase low-health Singed while walking through Singed Q Poison Trail. Go around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive to avoid being rooted by Singed E Fling while standing on it. Keep your distance if Singed is facing away from your allies, since he can fling you behind him.

Sion.build: Build armor first against Sion’s main sources of damage: Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage, so armor won’t stop them. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor when it hits, so focus on dodging it as well as building resistances.
Sion.combo: Your basic trade is to hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on. To start a fight, use Rumble E Electro Harpoon to raise your heat into the Danger Zone, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter. If you can cut off his escape route, place Rumble R The Equalizer first, then follow with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Sion.escape: After Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught has been used is a good window to get close. Make him end the charge of Sion Q Decimating Smash early or dodge sideways to avoid the knock-up and stun, then go in. Use the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield to close in, but account for the distance you’ll need to get back out.
Sion.fight: Avoid Sion’s crowd control and use Rumble E Electro Harpoon to manage your distance first. When Sion steps up for a last hit, hit him with the slow, keep him within Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range, and move while dealing damage. Right after Sion W Soul Furnace is activated, focus your damage on the shield and look for a chance to break it before it explodes.
Sion.laning: Poke from a safe distance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, and use Rumble Q Flamespitter only when you have an angle to get close. Rumble has no escape ability, so check river vision if you’ve pushed the lane too far, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield to disengage when you lack vision. If you keep giving Sion CS, his max health will increase, so disrupt his farming or gain an advantage in another lane.
Sion.phase: Early on, Rumble can hold his own in trades against physical melee opponents, but manage your distance to avoid Sion Q Decimating Smash. Later, Rumble will have a harder time getting close while Sion keeps gaining max health from CS, so use your mid-game strength to build an advantage.
Sion.teamfight: Enter from behind your frontline and catch several enemy frontline champions in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range. Lower Sion’s magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, too. Place Rumble R The Equalizer between the enemy frontline and backline, or across their retreat route. When Sion goes down, reposition until Sion P Glory in Death ends.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, move sideways to avoid the knock-up and stun. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; sidestep it. After taking Sion down, reposition to avoid the fast attacks and max-health damage from Sion P Glory in Death.

Skarner.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against the magic damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. If you need a cleanse against the suppression from Skarner R Impale, decide in advance whether to build Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar.
Skarner.combo: Your basic trade is to hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter. Use the second harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep the short-range Rumble Q Flamespitter on. If you continue the fight, watch your heat and leave room to turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter in the Danger Zone.
Skarner.escape: Watch out for Skarner R Impale, and don’t chase recklessly within its grab range. When retreating, use the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield and don’t put your back to a wall.
Skarner.fight: While Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is available, poke from a distance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon. Once the dash has been used, slow him and move in, keeping him in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s cone. When closing in, watch your heat and use the shield and movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield.
Skarner.laning: When Skarner steps up for a last hit, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, then make a short trade with Rumble Q Flamespitter. Don’t turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter first if you have no angle to get close. If you’ve pushed the lane too far, check river vision, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield to escape when you lack vision.
Skarner.phase: Early on, Rumble has low magic resistance, so focus first on surviving Skarner’s magic damage. Later, Rumble can have trouble getting close and be easily burst down, while Skarner’s tank items also increase his damage, so play to avoid being caught first.
Skarner.teamfight: Enter from behind your frontline and overlap Rumble Q Flamespitter on several enemies in their frontline, including Skarner. Lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, too. Place Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline or across their escape route. Near the edge of an objective pit, watch out for Skarner R Impale’s pull range.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain, and if he catches you and you hit a wall, you’re stunned. Don’t put your back to a wall; keep your distance in open space. Rumble W Scrap Shield can’t get you out of suppression from Skarner R Impale, so watch your position before entering its short range.

Teemo.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Teemo’s main damage is magic, and Rumble has low magic resistance, so fit Force of Nature between your core items to give yourself more time to stay close.
Teemo.combo: Your basic trade is to hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to amplify the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on. When entering a fight, watch your heat, use Rumble E Electro Harpoon to reach the Danger Zone, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter. If Rumble R The Equalizer is available, cut off Teemo’s escape route, then follow the slow from Rumble E Electro Harpoon with Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo Q Blinding Dart has been used is your chance to engage using basic attacks too. If Teemo W Move Quick has been used, he has no way to create distance, so slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and close in all at once.
Teemo.fight: When Teemo steps forward to last-hit, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and close the distance. Use the shield and movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield to get close, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter and move while turning to keep Teemo in its range. If Teemo Q Blinding Dart is available, don’t rely on Rumble P Junkyard Titan’s empowered attack to win the fight.
Teemo.laning: Early on, withstand Teemo’s magic damage and poke safely with Rumble E Electro Harpoon. Avoid trades where you get hit once by Teemo E Toxic Shot and back off; only slow him and follow up with Rumble Q Flamespitter when you have an angle to close in. If you’ve pushed the lane too far, check river vision, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield to escape when you lack vision.
Teemo.phase: Later, Rumble can have trouble getting close and be easily burst down, so don’t give Teemo time to stack Teemo R Noxious Trap in chokepoints.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap around objectives and in narrow passages, and watch out for traps along shortcuts when retreating. From behind your frontline, Rumble should find a position where several enemies overlap in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range, and lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help allied mages deal damage. Place Rumble R The Equalizer between the enemy frontline and backline or across their escape route to split their formation.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so if you’re hit, don’t try to use Rumble P Junkyard Titan’s empowered attack; deal damage with abilities or retreat. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies poison damage even from one basic attack, so stay outside attack range when you aren’t ready to close in. Also watch out for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in bushes without vision and Teemo R Noxious Trap in chokepoints.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle’s basic attacks and Trundle Q Chomp. If the healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute offsets the damage over time from Rumble Q Flamespitter, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage and steals resistances, so prioritize creating distance over stacking more magic resistance.
Trundle.combo: Your basic trade is to hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on. To start a fight, use Rumble E Electro Harpoon to reach the Danger Zone, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter. If you can block his escape route, place Rumble R The Equalizer first, then follow with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Trundle.escape: Your chance to go in is after Trundle E Pillar of Ice has been used and Trundle W Frozen Domain has expired. Slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and close in with the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so once you catch him, you can keep pressuring him until he uses Flash.
Trundle.fight: Fight outside Trundle W Frozen Domain after Trundle E Pillar of Ice has been used. Slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to get into range of the short-range Rumble Q Flamespitter, and use Rumble W Scrap Shield for movement speed and a shield as you close in. Create distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active, then fight again.
Trundle.laning: When Trundle steps forward to last-hit, poke with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter only when you have an angle to get close. Trundle heals around the wave with Trundle P King’s Tribute, so after lowering his health, take an advantage right away or push the lane to force him to recall. If you’ve pushed the lane too far, check river vision, and save Rumble W Scrap Shield to escape when you lack vision.
Trundle.phase: Early on, watch out for Trundle’s strong basic attacks, but Rumble can hold his own in short trades against physical melee opponents. Later, Rumble will have a harder time getting close, so avoid forcing a solo engage.
Trundle.teamfight: Enter from behind your frontline and hit several enemies in their frontline with Rumble Q Flamespitter. Lower Trundle’s magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, too. Place Rumble R The Equalizer between their frontline and backline or across their escape route. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, attack a different target or create distance.
Trundle.watch: Trundle becomes stronger in attack speed and healing on Trundle W Frozen Domain, so retreat outside it and fight after it expires. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks escape routes in narrow paths, so fight in open terrain and sidestep as soon as the pillar appears. When Trundle R Subjugate is activated, your resistances are reduced and Trundle becomes tankier, so create distance with the movement speed from Rumble W Scrap Shield.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s physical damage. Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage and Udyr Q Wilding Claw has mixed damage, so armor alone won’t block all of it. If the healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle offsets the damage over time from Rumble Q Flamespitter, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Udyr.combo: Your basic trade is to hit twice with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to build up the slow and magic resistance reduction, then keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on. To start a fight, check your heat, use Rumble E Electro Harpoon to enter the Danger Zone, then turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter. When using Rumble R The Equalizer, cut off Udyr’s escape route, then follow with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and Rumble Q Flamespitter.
Udyr.escape: Right after you force Udyr to use Udyr E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the distance or pick Udyr off. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so don’t go in expecting crowd control to work during that window.
Udyr.fight: Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone, unleash your damage and don’t give him time to heal. If you’ve already taken Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s stun once, then while it can’t be applied again to the same target immediately, slow him with Rumble E Electro Harpoon and keep Rumble Q Flamespitter on.
Udyr.laning: Don’t move forward while Udyr is out of sight; use vision at key paths and jungle entrances to track his gank route. Poke safely with Rumble E Electro Harpoon, and turn on Rumble Q Flamespitter only when you have an angle to close in. If you’ve pushed the lane too far and have no river vision, save Rumble W Scrap Shield to escape.
Udyr.phase: Early on, Rumble can hold his own in trades against physical melee opponents, but he’s weak to magic damage, so watch out for Udyr’s ganks and Udyr R Wingborne Storm. Later, Rumble can be easily burst down while closing in, so don’t go deep first.
Udyr.teamfight: From behind your frontline, find a position where several enemies are in Rumble Q Flamespitter’s range, and lower their magic resistance with Rumble E Electro Harpoon to help your allied mages deal damage, too. Instead of forcing damage onto Udyr, who has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle, take out the weaker enemies behind him first, then finish Udyr with your numbers advantage. Place Rumble R The Equalizer between the enemy frontline and backline or across their escape route to split their formation.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede dashes quickly and stuns, so keep your distance right after he activates a new stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on max health, and if you also get hit by R’s slow, it’s difficult to get away.
